status: Retained native DRC boundary metric adoption; the complete properties.md goal remains active.
scope: Replace 52 finite/report metric calls in 14 production check modules plus the prepared net-clearance cache path. The shared metric consumes authoritative regularized native material and hole contours. Finite legacy geometry remains test-only.
contract: PreparedRegionBoundary exposes fallible boundary distance, inclusive boundary-clearance and point-clearance queries. Valid empty boundaries have no distance and do not satisfy a threshold; invalid construction and unsupported native boundaries remain typed uncertainty.

Every required metric comparison runs under STRICT with work-budget guards. An enclosing display preview cannot supply its tolerance. Optional certified outward finite bounds schedule candidates; absent bounds retain candidates, and unresolved exact lower bounds do not reject them.
Native filled-region boundaries exclude authored internal seams and include holes. Native circle distance and point thresholds are independent of report sampling.

Only successful prepared boundaries enter the local constraint cache. Every warm query still checks the current shared budget. Unknown nearest-candidate comparisons and query failures no longer become zero, a dropped candidate, or an arbitrary minimum.

Check gateways retain requested check and layers in geometry-uncertainty findings. ReadinessRunner marks the affected execution Uncertain, preserves the reason, and does not poison later checks. Shared check implementation version is now 2; registry schema remains 1.

The constraint index retains missing bounds and uses outward finite sorting keys; missing bounds and undecided bounds comparisons disable rejection. Differential same-layer nearest fallback now measures all pairs instead of returning the first pair.

cost.kind: Candidate-only capability cost; repaired native and report-chord semantics differ. No matched-baseline speedup claim.
limitations: Field preparation excludes original input rectangle construction; whole-process RSS includes it.
The two-second field query gate, all 2,000 squares and 64 probes, and full fixture datasets remain unchanged.
Linked test/fixture executable sizes include their harnesses; no library-size delta or allocation count was measured.
The full fixture smoke timing is a single observation.

replay.conditions: Run from repository root. Output directories must not exist. Wait for all validation, build and test jobs to exit before the serial CPU-0 cost run. Retained scripts differ from the original temporary runners only in output-directory arguments and an unused import.

remaining: This does not certify every check: several older finite spatial indices and report-bound shortcuts can still omit candidates or require finite compatibility coordinates.

Component/projection caches, report-ring fallback promotion, and projection panics still need fallible authoritative handling. Some callers split features through to_multipolygon before retaining each native polygon.
The translated_circle compatibility wrapper still expects admitted construction and can panic on unresolved or denied input. Other source shapes and formats remain under audit.

Area, width, containment, source-value and other Option/filter_map consumers still need complete uncertainty propagation. Some non-distance threshold and sorting helpers still assume comparable values.
General rational-curve boundary distance remains a typed blocker. More curve families need independent native metric certificates.
